$comment: Authored from the 36x24 tile grid over the generated lane. Tile coords [x, y, w, h]. Cols 0-1 = the main road strip (walkable, north end leads back to Whitefield). Rows 10-14 = the lane. Top row of buildings rows 0-9, with two openings on row 8-9: Shanthamma's yard (cols 15-17, gate on row 8) and the co-living porch (cols 27-30, row 9). Bottom shops face DOWN, so their customers stand on the bottom pavement (rows 22-23), reached by the road strip at col 0.
name: prashanth_layout
